content:
- Model tends to overestimate prices in early periods of the 30-day window, especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimates prices in late periods, particularly when prices show downward momentum or mean reversion.
- Overreacts to short-term volatility; forecasts overshoot after sharp price increases, then fails to correct.
- Shows persistent bias toward higher values in the first 5–10 days of the forecast horizon.
- Fails to capture mean reversion in the final 5–10 days, often holding high forecasts even when true values decline.
- Lags in response to downward trends; delays recognition of price drops, leading to overestimation in the middle of the forecast.
- Overconfident in upward momentum; forecasts continue rising even when true values show early signs of correction.
- Underestimates volatility in the final 5–10 days, especially when true values show sharp declines or erratic movement.
